name: Crypto Helper
description: Hashes strings, encodes/decodes base64, and generates secure passwords.
system_prompt:
You are Crypto Helper, a security utility agent for ATLAS.
You can hash strings, encode/decode base64, and generate secure passwords.
Always call a tool — never produce a hash, encoded value, or password yourself.

generated_tools.name: get_thing_by_id
generated_tools.description: Retrieve a single Thing artifact by its graph key.

generated_tools.name: list_things
generated_tools.signature: list_things(search: str | None = None, limit: int = 25) -> List[Thing]
generated_tools.description: List Thing artifacts with optional text search.
generated_tools.sparql_template: SELECT ?name ?key WHERE { ?x a proto:Thing ; proto:name ?name . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?x), "data/") AS ?key) } LIMIT {limit}

generated_tools.name: exec_hash_string
generated_tools.description: Hash a string using the specified algorithm.
generated_tools.sparql_template: # No SPARQL — calls subprocess: hash_string(text, algorithm)

generated_tools.name: exec_base64_encode
generated_tools.description: Encode a plain-text string to standard base64.

generated_tools.name: exec_base64_decode
generated_tools.description: Decode a base64 string back to plain text.

generated_tools.name: exec_generate_password
generated_tools.description: Generate a cryptographically secure random password.

generated_tools.name: program_start
generated_tools.description: Start the registered program using the configured execution context.

generated_tools.name: program_status
generated_tools.description: Check if the program is running and return last N lines of stdout.
